assessmentBasis.rule: Historical exact-candidate evidence identifies the shortest closeout path. Behavior, browser, review and deployed evidence remains exact-candidate only; byte-identical independently hash-bound lockfile/config evidence may transfer under the G11-V4 risk-based closeout contract. Every non-removed customer claim must be proven on the frozen closeout fingerprint or explicitly classified N/A.

claims.text: Free Competitor Watch scans weekly on the Monday slot; Scout monitoring every 6 hours; Starter and Agency monitoring every 3 hours.
claims.surface: plan catalog, marketing, dashboard and watchlists
claims.requiredEvidence: same-fingerprint schedule, dispatch, completion, retry and deployed scan-health evidence
claims.assessment: 2026-07-20 integration drift: the free plan gained a weekly Monday scan (Free Weekly Competitor Watch), changing the cadence claim. Historical exact-candidate proof covered paid cadences only; the changed claim needs fresh dispatch/completion/recovery evidence on the merged candidate before any closeout.
claims.expiry: any plan, cron, workflow or cadence-copy change

claims.text: Included evidence checks reset on the entitlement cadence; unused included checks do not roll over; purchased packs do not expire and require an active paid plan to spend.
claims.requiredEvidence: current Dodo lifecycle, usage-ledger, cancellation retention and top-up spend canaries
claims.assessment: Historical exact candidate has billing lifecycle, ledger and cleanup evidence; the closeout candidate must repeat the exact Gate B/C billing proof after source freeze.
claims.expiry: any entitlement, SKU, billing-policy or provider change

claims.text: Customer-visible plan features come from the authoritative entitlement catalog; undeclared features remain unavailable.
claims.surface: pricing, billing and plan-gated customer navigation
claims.requiredEvidence: executable catalog parity plus same-fingerprint plan-boundary and pre-click denial proof
claims.assessment: The closeout registry binds every authoritative plan feature to one executable inventory; 2026-07-20 integration drift added weekly_digest and email_delivery to the free plan (Free Weekly Competitor Watch), so catalog parity plus exact browser and deployed entitlement proof must repeat on the merged candidate.
claims.expiry: any plan feature, entitlement, pricing or navigation change

claims.text: Reads ad text in 30+ languages and scripts and auto-translates it into English.
claims.requiredEvidence: bounded language corpus plus deployed Workers AI model/binding and fallback evidence
claims.assessment: The unbounded 30+ language promise is removed from plan copy in the closeout candidate; translation runtime remains non-promoted until a bounded corpus and deployed binding proof exist.
claims.expiry: translation copy, model, binding or provider change

claims.text: Free includes one weekly Competitor Watch watchlist — an activation scan, then a weekly Monday scan feeding a weekly brief email — without instant alerts, evidence checks, collections or exports.
claims.surface: dashboard, watchlists, Help and public documentation
claims.requiredEvidence: authoritative first-scan completion/recovery, weekly-scan and weekly-brief delivery, cap and pre-click plan-boundary proof
claims.assessment: 2026-07-20 integration drift: the overnight stack replaced activation-only free with the recurring Free Weekly Competitor Watch (weekly scan + weekly brief). Historical Journey 2 activation-only proof no longer matches the claim; the changed free contract needs fresh proof at all three widths and deployed identity.
claims.expiry: free-plan, first-scan, weekly-scan, digest, copy or entitlement change

claims.text: Results usually land within a couple of minutes.
claims.requiredEvidence: predeclared p75/p95 configuration-to-proof soak with delayed/failure/recovery truth
claims.assessment: The unsupported couple-of-minutes promise is removed from customer and recovery copy; completion remains truthful and state-based until a predeclared latency SLO is proven.
claims.expiry: workflow, provider, queue, copy or SLO change

claims.text: Quiet hours use a valid IANA timezone such as Asia/Kolkata or UTC.
claims.surface: watchlist delivery UI and API/MCP action
claims.requiredEvidence: invalid-input rejection, legacy UTC fallback, DST-boundary exactly-once delivery and deployed internal receipt
claims.assessment: Deterministic policy tests exist for timezone validation, UTC fallback and DST behavior; exact closeout browser and deployed internal receipt proof remains required.
claims.expiry: timezone, quiet-hours, API schema, cron or delivery-policy change

claims.text: Source status distinguishes live readiness, recent cache, setup-needed and unavailable states without inferring health from configuration.
claims.requiredEvidence: current provider health/retest, encrypted owner-only token and degraded recovery on exact deployed version
claims.assessment: Historical all-six browser proof and provider canary cover source-state truth; the closeout candidate must repeat degraded recovery and exact deployed provider identity.
claims.expiry: provider, token, health or copy change

claims.text: Exported customer navigation, public Markdown and sitemap paths remain explicitly inventoried; rendered access-boundary proof stays a separate release gate.
claims.surface: dashboard navigation, public markdown and sitemap
claims.requiredEvidence: executable exported-catalog parity plus same-fingerprint public/authenticated route and access-boundary proof
claims.assessment: The closeout registry now binds the exported customer navigation, public markdown and sitemap catalogs; rendered and deployed route proof remains required.
claims.expiry: any customer navigation, public path, sitemap or access-boundary change

claims.text: Email is the default delivery channel. Slack and Teams incoming-webhook delivery of confirmed changes are live Starter+ customer channels (2026-08-12 decision); WhatsApp remains unsupported until separately enabled and proven.
claims.surface: notifications, public docs, API/MCP and delivery runtime
claims.requiredEvidence: no dormant-channel leak plus exact-version controlled inbox delivery/open/link, suppression where provider-supported, retry/dedupe/unsubscribe and recipient privacy proof; Slack/Teams webhook acceptance recorded as delivered only on 2xx
claims.assessment: Slack/Teams webhook delivery is fail-closed: 2xx acceptance is the only delivery proof, unknown outcomes are recorded as provider_unknown, and provisional changes are labelled unconfirmed. Final configured-sender authentication, controlled inbox, suppression/retry/dedupe/unsubscribe and safe HTML/plain-text email evidence remains open.
claims.expiry: channel flag, provider, UI, API/MCP or delivery change

claims.text: Agency includes three seats with the owner included and shared workspace resources.

claims.assessment: Historical Journey 6 proof covers seat caps, membership and recovery; closeout exact-browser and deployed reconciliation must repeat after freeze.
claims.expiry: role, seat, membership or entitlement change

claims.assessment: Historical Journey 4 proof covers client-room state and delivery; closeout exact-browser, approval/revoke and deployed cleanup must repeat.
claims.expiry: plan, approval, report, room or share change

claims.assessment: Historical API/MCP account-scope tests cover replay, redaction and revoked-key fences; closeout exact deployed parity must repeat.

claims.text: 0509.io is canonical; only intended public routes are indexable and private/token/operator surfaces remain non-indexed.

Prior canonical/robots/sitemap proof predates these surfaces; indexing claims need fresh proof on the merged candidate. 2026-08-09: the proof-backed /competitor-monitoring category page joined the sitemap (route, canonical, WebPage+FAQ JSON-LD, source/freshness limits, and sample labeling are asserted in tests); the claim stays assessed_pending_reproof, no proof fabricated.
claims.expiry: route, metadata, host, robots, sitemap or header change

claims.assessment: Controlled delivery canaries passed historically, but SPF/DKIM/DMARC, bounce/complaint suppression and dark-mode client rendering are not yet complete on one exact deployment.
